facts: John-117 is identified firing an M6/R at the Battle of Installation 00.
The M6 is a portable shoulder-fired solid-state laser; source describes a charging indicator.
The M6/R is described as the Human-Covenant War variant.
sources.application: Chief and Johnson super rows hold a bulky physical shoulder launcher with a red charging point and laser discharge. The four-pose choreography and effect extent are generated adaptations.

sources.application: His ordinary BR55 and the super M6/R remain distinguishable. The local bareheaded face design is retained; this read does not establish that every official costume lacks a cap.
